criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import subtract` succeeds, and `subtract` is defined in src/app_int/main.py.
[R2] inspect.signature(subtract) has exactly two parameters, named 'a' then 'b', both positional-or-keyword with no defaults.
[R4] subtract(2, 5) == -3, subtract(0, 0) == 0, subtract(7, 0) == 7, subtract(-4, -6) == 2, and subtract(-3, 2) == -5.
[R5] subtract's annotations are int for parameters 'a' and 'b' and int for the return type (`int` or the string 'int' under `from __future__ import annotations`).
[R7] health_check() == {'status': 'ok'} and add(2, 3) == 5 still hold, and the existing tests in tests/test_main.py are kept and pass.
[R8] At least one test function under tests/ imports subtract from app_int.main and asserts on its return value.
[R9] The subtract tests include at least one assertion where the expected result is positive and at least one where it is negative, so a b - a implementation would fail them.
[R10] `uv run pytest -q` exits with code 0 and reports no failures or errors.
[R11] `uv run ruff check .` exits with code 0.
[R12] The [project].dependencies and [dependency-groups] sections of pyproject.toml are the same as on the base branch.
